profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Walmart Labs DC Metro (TN Visa)
profile.summary: Software engineer with 7+ years of experience. Experienced in design, implementation and maintenance of OOP Applications based on Java. Daily work includes, Java, Spring, Maven and Kafka. Design Pattern enthusiastic, I try to find patterns and apply them whenever it's suitable. Constantly searching for best practices to achieve Clean Code. Follow the SOLID principles, YAGNI, and DRY. Initiated in TDD. Extensive experience in technologies required for the creation and maintenance of an environment such as: VBScript, SQL Server, Autosys, Bash & Batch Scripting and Jenkins. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and a good team player. Ability to learn a new technology quickly and seamlessly manage workload to meet deadlines.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Design and development of new functionality for existing applications with Java-GraphQL-MariaDB-Kafka-Spring, and React-Graphql-Javascript technologies
Maintenance of the systems in the area store financials
Applied design patterns for a better re usability, lower maintenance cost of sub modules and easier understanding using a common technical language
Improved testing practices

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created from scratch a Kotlin Android Native application and a Backend in Kotlin with Spring, Hibernate and Gradle to improve the delivery process of a delivery company.

This applications helped the persons doing the delivery to get information in real time, guide them to their next destination, keep the history of the deliveries, and sync the deliveries with the existing legacy application through the backend service.

 Configured the build automation tool to generate a fat jar that was used as an artifact for deployment in the client box.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Design and development of new functionality for existing Java applications Spring based.
Maintenance of the systems in the area of investments and capital markets.
Enhancement of Jenkins jobs for the automation of the deployment.
Maintained and improved VBScripts & Unix Scripts for the Batch servers.
Developed small scripts as well as Java applications for the small process between the team helping to automate the process.
Continuous support for all the E2E testings, documenting the process and recurrent challenges.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Successfully created from scratch 4 Java Micro Services using Spring REST, Spring MVC and Spring Boot for the use of the of Investors, with constant communication with a team in NY to achieve the requirements of the customer.

Constant use of best practices to achieve Quality Assurance such as TDD for testing and design, Pair programming and code revisions to share the knowledge and improve the quality work on the team,  constant use of sequential diagrams to make a clear idea of what it's going to be done and see where we can reuse code.  

All of this in the methodology of Agile for the continuous delivery in tight timeliness 

Successfully reduced 3 version of the code into 1 using Maven and Ant to tokenize the code.

All previously listed tasks and responsibilities listed from my position in the company (Hexaware Technologies) from 2016 to 2018 apply.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintenance of OOP Applications based on Java using Spring and Hibernate, On call support for applications used for people management. 
Using SQL Server, JSP, Java, Junit, Spring, GIT & Jenkins.  
Focused on Best practices to achieve Quality Code.
Participated in all phases of the software development life cycle.

company.name: General Coordination of Information Technologies from The Autonomous University of Chihuahua

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of an Android application specialized for the control of inventory, using:
Ruby on Rails, SQL Server and Java.
Maintenance of systems in the University of Chihuahua with Java, VB.Net, VB6, SQL Server, under SVN and GIT.
Given Technical support over the phone with system users for the University.
Conducted multiple trainings regarding the functionality of systems at different University Faculties.

positions.title: Practical Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintenance of the University system inventory assets.
Carefully reviewed and guided by my technical lead in order to successfully merge and deploy the code in production.

educations.schoolName: School of Engineering of the Autonomous University of Chihuahua
